Jo pregnancy woh chahti hai use khatam karne ke liye push karna utna hi galat hai jitna us pregnancy ko continue karne ke liye push karna jo woh nahi chahti.

## Practical baatein: paisa, travel, privacy

Sabse pehle time. Doctors pregnancy ko uske last period ke pehle din se ginte hain, isliye woh sex ki date se lagne wale andaze se zyada aage hoti hai, aur abortion pills sirf nau hafte, yaani 63 din tak approved hain, woh bhi qualified doctor ke prescription par [[mohfw-cac-guidelines-2023]]. Isi hafte use ek registered doctor tak pahunchne mein madad kijiye.

Uski taraf se chemist ke paas kit lene mat jaiye: doctor ke bina koi confirm nahi karta ki pregnancy kitne hafte ki hai ya pills uske liye theek hain ya nahi. Doctor ke saath abortion bahut safe hai. WHO ke mutabiq safe abortion se hone wali deaths 100,000 abortions par 1 se bhi kam hain [[who-abortion-factsheet-2025]].

Paisa: NFHS-5 mein jin auraton ki last pregnancy abortion mein khatam hui, unme se 52.9% ne private sector mein aur 20.3% ne public sector mein abortion karwaya [[nfhs5-india-2021]], isliye yeh maan kar chaliye ki bill aayega. Bina kahe kam se kam aadha paisa dijiye. Paise dene se aapko vote nahi mil jaata.

Travel: us din chhutti lijiye, agar woh chahe toh saath jaiye, aur use ghar tak chhodiye. Baad mein bahut zyada bleeding, bukhaar ya tez dard ho, toh usi din hospital jaana hai.

Privacy: jo doctor uska naam ya details kisi aise insaan ko bataye jise law ne authorise nahi kiya, use ek saal tak ki jail ho sakti hai [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. Aap par aisa koi law laagu nahi hota, isliye yeh rule khud par laagu kijiye. Jab tak woh na kahe, kisi dost, cousin ya parent ko mat bataiye.

## Agar aap sehmat nahi hain

Ho sakta hai aap yeh pregnancy chahte hon aur woh nahi. Ek baar, imaandaari se, apni feeling ki tarah kahiye, demand ki tarah nahi, aur phir uska jawaab maan lijiye. Act aapko koi veto nahi deta, aur hafte bhar ki behes sirf uske calendar ke din khaati hai.

Ya ho sakta hai aap abortion chahte hon aur woh continue karna chahti ho. Aap yeh zabardasti nahi karwa sakte. Aurat ki consent ke bina miscarriage karwana Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita ke Section 89 ke tehat crime hai, jiski saza das saal tak ki jail ya life imprisonment hai [[gazette-bns-2023]]. Use bina bataye abortion pills de dena isi section ke daayre mein aa sakta hai.

Dono hi surat mein aapko relief, guilt ya dukh mehsoos ho sakta hai. Recovery ke dauraan in feelings ko sambhalna uska kaam nahi hai. Kisi aise insaan se baat kijiye jise batane mein use aitraaz na ho, ya Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kijiye [[tele-manas]].

## Vasectomy 0.3% par kyun atki hai, aur ab se aapka hissa

NFHS-5 mein 37.9% currently married auratein female sterilisation par nirbhar thi, jo saare modern contraceptive use ka lagbhag do-tihaai hai. Male sterilisation 0.3% par tha [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Har us husband ke muqable jisne sterilisation karwaya hai, sau se zyada wives ne karwaya hai.

Survey mardon se iski wajah nahi poochta. Lekin unke apne jawaab ek wajah ki taraf ishaara karte hain: isi survey mein 15-49 saal ke 35.1% mardon ne maana ki contraception "women's business and a man should not have to worry about it" hai, yaani yeh auraton ka kaam hai aur mard ko iski fikr nahi karni chahiye [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Aapka hissa abhi se shuru hota hai: abortion ke baad fertility jaldi laut sakti hai, isliye usi visit par doctor se contraception ke baare mein poochiye [[nhm-cac]]. Typical use mein, external condom par nirbhar 100 mein se lagbhag 13 auratein pehle saal mein pregnant ho jaati hain, jabki withdrawal ke saath lagbhag 20 aur bina kisi method ke lagbhag 85 [[who-fp]]. Condom khud khareediye aur har baar use kijiye. Agar condom phat jaaye, toh emergency contraception sex ke paanch din baad tak kaam karti hai, aur jitni jaldi li jaaye utna behtar [[who-ec]]. Agar aapki family complete ho chuki hai, toh doctor se vasectomy ke baare mein poochiye.

Isme se kuch bhi aapse hero banne ko nahi kehta. Bas itna kehta hai ki aap maujood rahein, apna hissa pay karein, uska raaz rakhein aur ab se contraception ka aadha bojh khud uthayein.

pcpndt-act-enforcement-31-cases-2024.en:
Imagine an ultrasound room in a district town. The scan is routine, and the doctor never says the word "boy" or "girl". On the way out, someone at the counter smiles at the mother-in-law and tells her to get the sweets ready. Under Indian law that can still be a crime, because the ban covers words, signs "or any other manner". Across the whole country in 2024, police registered 31 cases under that law [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

## The law on paper: no words, no signs

The Pre-Natal Diagnostic Techniques Act of 1994 came into operation on 1 January 1996. An amendment in force from 14 February 2003 renamed it the Pre-Conception and Pre-Natal Diagnostic Techniques (Prohibition of Sex Selection) Act and extended it to sex selection before conception [[mohfw-pndt-act-rules-2003]]. It bans sex selection before or after conception, and the misuse of prenatal tests to find out a foetus's sex [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]].

Its central rule, Section 5(2), is strict. No one, including the person conducting the test, may tell the pregnant woman, her relatives or anyone else the sex of the foetus "by words, signs or in any other manner" [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]].

The penalties aim at the people who own the machines. Under Section 23, a doctor or clinic owner who breaks the law faces up to three years in prison and a fine of up to Rs 10,000, rising to five years and Rs 50,000 for a repeat offence [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]]. The doctor's registration is suspended once a court frames charges, and removed for five years on a first conviction and permanently on a second [[indiacode-pcpndt-1994]]. Anyone who seeks sex selection faces up to three years and a fine of up to Rs 50,000, rising to five years and Rs 1 lakh. But the law presumes that a pregnant woman was compelled by her husband or relatives, and it does not punish a woman who was forced [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]].

## The numbers: 57, 30, 31

Police registered 57 cases under the Act in 2022, 30 in 2023 and 31 in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. That is for all of India, under a law that covers every clinic and scan centre offering prenatal tests.

Now set that beside what the law exists to stop. UNFPA estimated that about 460,000 girls a year went "missing" at birth in India between 2013 and 2017 [[unfpa-swop-2020]]. Pew Research Center put the yearly figure at about 410,000 in 2019, and counted at least 9.0 million female births missing between 2000 and 2019 because of female-selective abortions [[pew-india-sex-ratio-2022]]. These estimates cover different years from the police data, so they cannot be turned into a neat ratio, but the difference in scale is impossible to miss.

The birth ratio shows the practice has slowed, not stopped. India went from about 111 boys born per 100 girls in the 2011 census to about 109 in NFHS-4 (2015-16) and 108 in NFHS-5 (2019-21), against a natural level of about 105 [[pew-india-sex-ratio-2022]].

## Complaint-only: who can take a clinic to court

Part of the gap is written into the law. Section 27 makes every offence under the Act cognisable, non-bailable and non-compoundable, the language of serious crime: police can arrest without a warrant, bail is not automatic, and the case cannot be settled privately. But Section 28 says no court can take up a case except on a complaint by the Appropriate Authority, an officer it authorises, or a person or social organisation that has given the authority at least 15 days' notice [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]].

So prosecution rests on Appropriate Authorities, the officials appointed in each state and district to run the Act, often health officials, choosing to file complaints. The officials who oversee the clinics are the ones expected to take them to court. Many PC-PNDT cases are filed as complaints in court rather than as police FIRs, so NCRB's tables, which count cases registered by the police, may miss them [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The 31 counts cases that came through one door; the Act sends most complainants through another.

## What the missing data hide

The most quoted number about this law therefore measures the wrong thing. Police data cannot show how many complaints Appropriate Authorities filed, how many reached a verdict, or how many doctors lost their registration. One of the Act's sharpest penalties, the loss of the right to practise, is invisible in the national crime statistics.

The practice itself shows through other cracks. In NFHS-5 (2019-21), 2.1% of women whose last pregnancy ended in abortion openly named a female foetus as the main reason; among the larger states, the share was highest in Bihar (5.3%), Jharkhand (4.9%) and Punjab (4.2%) [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Sex selection is a crime, so that self-report is almost certainly a large undercount.

The data also hide the woman at the centre. The law presumes she was compelled [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]]. That protects her from prosecution, but she is also the one witness who knows what was said in the scan room, and often the person in the family with the least power to say it.

## What would make the ban bite

Most of the tools already exist on paper. Citizens and social organisations can go to court themselves after 15 days' notice. A doctor's registration can be suspended as soon as charges are framed, without waiting for a verdict [[indiacode-pcpndt-1994]]. The Act also bans advertising sex-determination services, including online [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]].

What is missing is enforcement the public can see. Publishing, district by district, how many complaints were filed, how many ended in conviction and how many registrations were suspended would let anyone check whether the ban is working. Treating a woman's account as evidence against the clinic, never against her, would make it safer for her to speak.

Enforcement alone will not end sex selection, because the demand behind it is strong. In a 2014 survey in seven states, 81% of women and 76% of men said it was very important to have at least one son [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]]. While that demand lasts, only a ban that is visibly enforced will make a clinic think twice before it smiles at a family.

This is general information, not legal advice.
pcpndt-act-enforcement-31-cases-2024.hg:
Socho, kisi district town ka ek ultrasound room hai. Scan routine hai, aur doctor "ladka" ya "ladki" shabd kabhi nahi bolta. Bahar nikalte waqt counter par baitha koi insaan saas ki taraf muskura kar kehta hai ki mithai ka intezaam kar lo. Indian law mein yeh bhi crime ho sakta hai, kyunki ban shabdon, signs "ya kisi bhi aur tareeke" par lagta hai. Aur 2024 mein poore desh mein police ne is law ke tahat sirf 31 cases darj kiye [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

## Kaagaz par law: na shabd, na ishaare

Pre-Natal Diagnostic Techniques Act, 1994, 1 January 1996 se lagu hua. 14 February 2003 se lagu ek amendment ne iska naam badal kar Pre-Conception and Pre-Natal Diagnostic Techniques (Prohibition of Sex Selection) Act kar diya, aur ise conception se pehle ke sex selection tak badha diya [[mohfw-pndt-act-rules-2003]]. Yeh law conception se pehle ya baad sex selection par, aur foetus ka sex pata karne ke liye prenatal tests ke galat istemaal par ban lagata hai [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]].

Iska sabse zaroori rule, Section 5(2), bahut sakht hai. Koi bhi, test karne wala insaan bhi, pregnant aurat, uske rishtedaaron ya kisi aur ko foetus ka sex "shabdon se, signs se ya kisi bhi aur tareeke se" nahi bata sakta [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]].

Sazaaein un logon par nishaana saadhti hain jinke paas machines hain. Section 23 ke tahat law todne wale doctor ya clinic owner ko 3 saal tak ki jail aur Rs 10,000 tak ka fine ho sakta hai, aur dobara offence par 5 saal aur Rs 50,000 [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]]. Court jaise hi charges frame karti hai, doctor ka registration suspend ho jaata hai; pehli conviction par 5 saal ke liye hat jaata hai aur doosri par hamesha ke liye [[indiacode-pcpndt-1994]]. Jo koi sex selection karwana chahe, use 3 saal tak ki jail aur Rs 50,000 tak ka fine ho sakta hai, aur dobara karne par 5 saal aur Rs 1 lakh. Lekin law maan kar chalta hai ki pregnant aurat ko uske pati ya rishtedaaron ne majboor kiya tha, aur jis aurat ko majboor kiya gaya use saza nahi deta [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]].

## Numbers: 57, 30, 31

Police ne is Act ke tahat 2022 mein 57, 2023 mein 30 aur 2024 mein 31 cases darj kiye [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yeh poore India ka aankda hai, us law ke tahat jo prenatal tests karne wale har clinic aur scan centre par lagu hota hai.

Ab ise us cheez ke saamne rakho jise rokne ke liye yeh law bana hai. UNFPA ke estimate ke mutabik 2013 se 2017 ke beech India mein har saal lagbhag 460,000 ladkiyan janm ke waqt "missing" hui [[unfpa-swop-2020]]. Pew Research Center ne 2019 ke liye yeh saalana aankda lagbhag 410,000 bataya, aur hisaab lagaya ki 2000 se 2019 ke beech female-selective abortions ki wajah se kam se kam 9.0 million female births missing hui [[pew-india-sex-ratio-2022]]. Yeh estimates police data se alag saalon ke hain, isliye inka koi seedha ratio nahi banaya ja sakta, lekin scale ka farak nazar-andaaz karna namumkin hai.

Birth ratio dikhata hai ki yeh practice dheemi hui hai, ruki nahi. India mein 2011 ki census mein har 100 ladkiyon par lagbhag 111 ladke paida ho rahe the, NFHS-4 (2015-16) mein lagbhag 109 aur NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein 108, jabki natural level lagbhag 105 hai [[pew-india-sex-ratio-2022]].

## Sirf complaint se: clinic ko court kaun le ja sakta hai

Is gap ka ek hissa law mein hi likha hua hai. Section 27 is Act ke har offence ko cognisable, non-bailable aur non-compoundable banata hai, yaani serious crime wali bhasha: police bina warrant arrest kar sakti hai, bail apne aap nahi milti, aur case aapas mein settle nahi ho sakta. Lekin Section 28 kehta hai ki koi bhi court case tabhi uthayegi jab complaint Appropriate Authority kare, ya uska authorise kiya hua officer, ya koi insaan ya social organisation jisne authority ko kam se kam 15 din ka notice diya ho [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]].

Matlab prosecution Appropriate Authorities par tika hai, yaani har state aur district mein Act chalane ke liye appoint kiye gaye officials, aksar health officials, aur is par ki woh complaint file karna chunte hain ya nahi. Jo officials clinics par nazar rakhte hain, unhi se ummeed hai ki woh unhe court bhi le jaayein. Bahut se PC-PNDT cases police FIR ki jagah seedhe court mein complaint ke roop mein file hote hain, isliye NCRB ki tables, jo sirf police mein darj cases ginti hain, unhe miss kar sakti hain [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yeh 31 sirf ek darwaze se aaye cases ginta hai; Act zyada tar complaint karne walon ko doosre darwaze se bhejta hai.

## Gaayab data kya chhupa leta hai

Isliye is law ke baare mein sabse zyada quote hone wala number galat cheez naapta hai. Police data yeh nahi bata sakta ki Appropriate Authorities ne kitni complaints file ki, kitni verdict tak pahunchi, ya kitne doctors ka registration gaya. Act ki sabse kadi sazaaon mein se ek, practice karne ka haq chhin jaana, national crime statistics mein dikhti hi nahi.

Practice khud doosri daraaron se jhaankti hai. NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein jin aurton ki last pregnancy abortion par khatam hui, unmein se 2.1% ne khul kar female foetus ko main wajah bataya; bade states mein yeh hissa Bihar (5.3%), Jharkhand (4.9%) aur Punjab (4.2%) mein sabse zyada tha [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Sex selection crime hai, isliye yeh khud ka bataya hua aankda lagbhag pakka bahut kam karke aanka gaya hai.

Data beech mein khadi aurat ko bhi chhupa leta hai. Law maanta hai ki use majboor kiya gaya tha [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]]. Yeh use prosecution se bachata hai, lekin wahi akeli gawah hai jise pata hai ki scan room mein kya kaha gaya, aur aksar family mein wahi sabse kam taaqat wali hoti hai jo yeh bol sake.

## Ban ko asardaar kya banayega

Zyada tar tools kaagaz par pehle se maujood hain. Citizens aur social organisations 15 din ka notice dekar khud court ja sakte hain. Charges frame hote hi doctor ka registration suspend ho sakta hai, verdict ka intezaar kiye bina [[indiacode-pcpndt-1994]]. Act sex-determination services ke advertisement par bhi ban lagata hai, online bhi [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]].

Jo cheez gaayab hai, woh hai aisa enforcement jo public ko dikhe. Agar district-wise publish ho ki kitni complaints file hui, kitni conviction tak pahunchi aur kitne registrations suspend hue, toh koi bhi check kar sakta hai ki ban kaam kar raha hai ya nahi. Aurat ki baat ko clinic ke khilaaf saboot maana jaaye, kabhi uske khilaaf nahi, toh uske liye bolna zyada safe hoga.

Sirf enforcement se sex selection khatam nahi hoga, kyunki iske peeche ki demand mazboot hai. 2014 mein saat states ke ek survey mein 81% aurton aur 76% mardon ne kaha ki kam se kam ek beta hona bahut zaroori hai [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]]. Jab tak yeh demand hai, sirf wahi ban jo saaf dikhte hue lagu ho, kisi clinic ko family ki taraf muskurane se pehle do baar sochne par majboor karega.

Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

pregnancy-weeks-abortion-deadlines-guide.en:
Imagine a 21-year-old in Pune whose period is two weeks late. Her last period started six weeks ago; she had sex about four weeks ago, so she thinks she is four weeks pregnant. By the count that doctors and the law use, she is six. That gap matters: every option under India's abortion law has a deadline in weeks, and she has used up more time than she knows. This guide explains the count and the deadlines it controls. It is general information, not medical or legal advice.

## Counting from the last period, not from sex

Doctors date a pregnancy from the first day of the last menstrual period, written "LMP", because that date is usually known and the day of conception is not. Conception happens later, around ovulation, so the count starts before the pregnancy does. India's abortion guidelines run on the same clock: the limit for abortion pills is nine weeks, or 63 days, "LMP" [[mohfw-cac-guidelines-2023]].

So in a regular monthly cycle, a woman is already about four weeks pregnant on the day her period fails to arrive. To work out your own week, mark the first day of your last period on a calendar and count forward. Nine weeks is 63 days after that date.

If you cannot remember the date, or your periods are irregular, a doctor can estimate the week by examination or ultrasound. A home pregnancy test is most reliable once a period is missed; if it is negative and the period still does not come, repeat it after a few days.

If unprotected sex happened within the last five days, there may be no pregnancy to count yet. Emergency contraception works by delaying ovulation, can be used up to five days after sex, works better the sooner it is taken, and is not an abortion [[who-ec]].

## Up to 9 weeks: the pill window

Up to nine weeks (63 days), India's Health Ministry approves a combination of two medicines, mifepristone and misoprostol, which succeeds in 95-99% of early abortions. A qualified doctor can prescribe them at an ordinary outpatient clinic, as long as it is linked to an approved abortion facility [[mohfw-cac-guidelines-2023]].

The window was once seven weeks (49 days); a combination pack was approved up to nine weeks only in December 2008 [[mohfw-cac-guidelines-2018]].

The window is not a chemist's counter. In 2015 an estimated 11.5 million of India's 15.6 million abortions were medication abortions outside any health facility [[lancet-gh-abortion-india-2018]]. Without a doctor, nobody checks how far along the pregnancy really is, or whether it is ectopic, growing outside the womb, which needs urgent hospital care [[nhs-ectopic]].

## Up to 20 and 24 weeks: one doctor, then two

After nine weeks, the abortion itself must happen at a government hospital or a facility approved under the MTP Act. An abortion by anyone who is not a registered medical practitioner, or at an unapproved place, is punishable with two to seven years of rigorous imprisonment [[indiankanoon-mtp-act-1971-consolidated]].

Up to 20 weeks, one registered doctor's opinion is enough, if continuing the pregnancy would risk the woman's life or gravely injure her physical or mental health, or if there is a substantial risk of serious foetal abnormality [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. When a contraceptive used by "any woman or her partner" fails, the law presumes that grave injury to her mental health [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]].

From 20 to 24 weeks, two doctors must agree, and the woman must belong to one of seven categories in the 2021 rules, including survivors of sexual assault, rape or incest, minors, and women whose marital status changes during the pregnancy [[gazette-mtp-amendment-rules-2021]]. The Supreme Court held in 2022 that unmarried and single women get the same access in this window as married women [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]].

| Your week, counted from the last period | What the law allows | Who must agree |
|---|---|---|
| Up to 9 (63 days) | Pills on a qualified doctor's prescription, or a procedure | One doctor |
| 9 to 20 | Abortion at a government or approved facility | One doctor |
| 20 to 24 | Only for the seven listed categories | Two doctors |
| Beyond 24 | Only for a substantial foetal abnormality | A Medical Board |
| Beyond 24, any other reason | Only by court order | A High Court or the Supreme Court |

## After 24 weeks: boards and courts

Past 24 weeks, the law sets no upper limit only when a Medical Board diagnoses a substantial foetal abnormality. Every state and union territory must have such a board, with at least a gynaecologist, a paediatrician and a radiologist or sonologist [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. The board must give its opinion within three days of a request; if it approves, the abortion must be done within five days of the request [[gazette-mtp-amendment-rules-2021]].

Anyone else past 24 weeks, including a rape survivor or a girl who found out late, has no route under the Act except an emergency to save her life. She must petition a High Court or the Supreme Court, and wait [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. Our explainer on what happens after 24 weeks covers that road.

## Why waiting costs options

Go back to the calendar. In a regular cycle, the first missed period comes at about week four. Waiting for a second missed period "to be sure" takes her to about week eight, with roughly a week of the pill window left. A month of "let's see" can turn a prescription at a local clinic into a procedure at an approved facility, and a decision at week 19 into one at week 21 that needs two doctors and a listed category.

Other delays are avoidable too. If she is 18 or older, her own consent is the only one the law asks for; no husband, parent or in-law has to sign [[gazette-mtp-act-1971]]. A clinic that says otherwise is following habit, not law, and every day spent arguing comes off her calendar.

Deadlines are written in weeks but lived in days. Write down the date the last period started, and act on it early.
pregnancy-weeks-abortion-deadlines-guide.hg:
Pune ki ek 21 saal ki ladki ko imagine kijiye jiska period do hafte late hai. Uska last period chhe hafte pehle shuru hua tha; usne lagbhag chaar hafte pehle sex kiya tha, isliye woh sochti hai ki woh chaar hafte pregnant hai. Lekin jis tarah doctors aur law ginte hain, us hisaab se woh chhe hafte pregnant hai. Yeh fark maayne rakhta hai: India ke abortion law mein har option ki deadline hafton mein hai, aur woh jitna samajhti hai usse zyada waqt guzar chuka hai. Yeh guide batati hai ki ginti kaise hoti hai aur kaun si deadlines us par tiki hain. Yeh general information hai, medical ya legal advice nahi.

## Ginti last period se hoti hai, sex se nahi

Doctors pregnancy ko last menstrual period ke pehle din se ginte hain, jise "LMP" likha jaata hai, kyunki yeh date aam taur par pata hoti hai aur conception ka din nahi. Conception iske baad, ovulation ke aas-paas hota hai, isliye ginti pregnancy shuru hone se pehle hi shuru ho jaati hai. India ki abortion guidelines bhi isi ghadi par chalti hain: abortion pills ki limit nau hafte, yaani 63 din, "LMP" likhi gayi hai [[mohfw-cac-guidelines-2023]].

Yaani regular monthly cycle mein, jis din period nahi aata, us din aurat pehle se lagbhag chaar hafte pregnant hoti hai. Apna hafta nikaalne ke liye calendar par last period ka pehla din mark kijiye aur aage giniye. Nau hafte us date ke 63 din baad poore hote hain.

Agar aapko date yaad nahi, ya periods irregular hain, toh doctor examination ya ultrasound se hafta estimate kar sakta hai. Home pregnancy test period miss hone ke baad sabse reliable hota hai; agar negative aaye aur period phir bhi na aaye, toh kuch din baad dobara test kijiye.

Agar unprotected sex pichhle paanch din ke andar hua hai, toh ho sakta hai ki abhi ginne ke liye koi pregnancy ho hi nahi. Emergency contraception ovulation ko delay karke kaam karti hai, sex ke paanch din baad tak li ja sakti hai, jitni jaldi li jaaye utna behtar kaam karti hai, aur yeh abortion nahi hai [[who-ec]].

## 9 hafte tak: pills ki window

Nau hafte (63 din) tak India ki Health Ministry do dawaiyon, mifepristone aur misoprostol, ke combination ko approve karti hai, jo shuruaati abortions mein 95-99% cases mein kaamyaab hota hai. Ek qualified doctor inhe kisi aam outpatient clinic se bhi prescribe kar sakta hai, bas woh clinic kisi approved abortion facility se juda hona chahiye [[mohfw-cac-guidelines-2023]].

Yeh window kabhi saat hafte (49 din) ki thi; combination pack ko nau hafte tak ki approval December 2008 mein jaakar mili [[mohfw-cac-guidelines-2018]].

Yeh window chemist ka counter nahi hai. 2015 mein India ke andaazan 15.6 million abortions mein se 11.5 million aise medication abortions the jo kisi health facility ke bahar hue [[lancet-gh-abortion-india-2018]]. Doctor ke bina koi check nahi karta ki pregnancy asal mein kitne hafte ki hai, ya kahin woh ectopic toh nahi, yaani womb ke bahar toh nahi badh rahi, jiske liye turant hospital care chahiye [[nhs-ectopic]].

## 20 aur 24 hafte tak: pehle ek doctor, phir do

Nau hafte ke baad abortion khud kisi government hospital ya MTP Act ke under approved facility mein hi hona chahiye. Agar abortion koi aisa insaan kare jo registered medical practitioner nahi hai, ya kisi unapproved jagah par ho, toh do se saat saal tak ki rigorous imprisonment ho sakti hai [[indiankanoon-mtp-act-1971-consolidated]].

20 hafte tak ek registered doctor ki opinion kaafi hai, agar pregnancy jaari rakhne se aurat ki jaan ko risk ho, ya uski physical ya mental health ko gambhir nuksaan ho, ya bachche mein serious abnormality ka substantial risk ho [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. Jab "any woman or her partner", yaani kisi bhi aurat ya uske partner ka use kiya gaya contraceptive fail ho jaaye, toh law maan leta hai ki isse uski mental health ko gambhir nuksaan hota hai [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]].

20 se 24 hafte ke beech do doctors ka agree karna zaroori hai, aur aurat ko 2021 ke rules ki saat categories mein se kisi ek mein aana chahiye, jaise sexual assault, rape ya incest ki survivors, minors, aur woh aurtein jinka marital status pregnancy ke dauraan badal jaaye [[gazette-mtp-amendment-rules-2021]]. Supreme Court ne 2022 mein kaha ki is window mein unmarried aur single aurton ko bhi wahi access milega jo shaadishuda aurton ko milta hai [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]].

| Aapka hafta, last period se gin kar | Law kya allow karta hai | Kiski haan chahiye |
|---|---|---|
| 9 tak (63 din) | Qualified doctor ke prescription par pills, ya procedure | Ek doctor |
| 9 se 20 | Government ya approved facility mein abortion | Ek doctor |
| 20 se 24 | Sirf saat listed categories ke liye | Do doctors |
| 24 ke baad | Sirf substantial foetal abnormality ke liye | Medical Board |
| 24 ke baad, koi aur wajah | Sirf court ke order se | High Court ya Supreme Court |

## 24 hafte ke baad: boards aur courts

24 hafte ke baad law koi upper limit tabhi nahi rakhta jab Medical Board bachche mein substantial abnormality diagnose kare. Har state aur union territory mein aisa board hona zaroori hai, jismein kam se kam ek gynaecologist, ek paediatrician aur ek radiologist ya sonologist ho [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. Board ko request milne ke teen din ke andar apni opinion deni hoti hai; agar woh haan kahe, toh request ke paanch din ke andar abortion ho jaana chahiye [[gazette-mtp-amendment-rules-2021]].

24 hafte ke baad baaki sabke liye, jismein rape survivor ya der se pata chalne wali ladki bhi shaamil hai, Act mein jaan bachane wali emergency ke alawa koi raasta nahi hai. Use High Court ya Supreme Court mein petition daalni padti hai, aur intezaar karna padta hai [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. 24 hafte ke baad kya hota hai, is par hamara explainer us raaste ko detail mein samjhata hai.

## Intezaar karne se options kyun kam hote hain

Calendar par wapas chaliye. Regular cycle mein pehla missed period lagbhag chauthe hafte mein aata hai. "Pakka hone ke liye" doosre missed period ka intezaar karne se woh lagbhag aathve hafte tak pahunch jaati hai, aur pills ki window mein lagbhag ek hafta hi bachta hai. Ek mahine ka "dekhte hain" kisi local clinic ke prescription ko approved facility ke procedure mein badal sakta hai, aur 19ve hafte ke faisle ko 21ve hafte ka faisla bana sakta hai, jiske liye do doctors aur ek listed category chahiye.

Doosri deriyan bhi taali ja sakti hain. Agar woh 18 ya usse zyada ki hai, toh law sirf uski apni consent maangta hai; na pati, na maa-baap, na sasural walon ko sign karna hai [[gazette-mtp-act-1971]]. Jo clinic kuch aur kahe, woh aadat se chal raha hai, law se nahi, aur behas mein gaya har din uske calendar se kat jaata hai.

Deadlines hafton mein likhi hain, par jiya unhe dinon mein jaata hai. Last period shuru hone ki date likh lijiye, aur us par jaldi kadam uthaiye.

pregnant-after-rape-rights-guide-india.en:
Consider this situation. A 24-year-old in Patna was raped by a man she knows. Five weeks later her period has not come, and a test from the chemist shows two lines. She has not gone to the police and is not sure she ever will. What she needs now is not advice about her past but a calendar, because almost every right she has from here runs on a clock measured in weeks. This is that calendar, step by step. It is general information, not legal advice.

## Is she pregnant? Testing and counting the weeks

If the assault was less than five days ago, a pregnancy may still be prevented. Emergency contraception works by delaying ovulation; it does not end a pregnancy that has already begun, so it is not an abortion [[who-ec]]. Our guide to the first 72 hours after an assault covers that window. This guide starts where it ends.

Once a period is late, a urine test confirms most pregnancies. If it is negative and the period still does not come, test again after a few days. A doctor's examination, or an ultrasound when dates are unclear, then tells her how far along she is.

One detail catches families out. Doctors count a pregnancy's weeks from the first day of the last period, not from the day of the assault; the Health Ministry's nine-week (63-day) limit for abortion pills is counted that way [[mohfw-cac-guidelines-2023]]. On paper, the pregnancy is always further along than the days since the assault suggest. Every deadline below arrives sooner than she expects.

## What the law presumes, and what it does not demand

The Medical Termination of Pregnancy (MTP) Act says that when a woman states that her pregnancy was caused by rape, the anguish it causes is presumed to be a grave injury to her mental health. That presumption is a legal ground for ending the pregnancy [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. She does not have to show that she is suffering. The law assumes it.

She does not have to prove the rape either. On 29 September 2022 the Supreme Court held that no FIR needs to be registered, and the allegation need not be proved in any court, before it is accepted for the MTP Act. The same judgment read "rape" in the Act to include rape by a husband, so a wife pregnant from forced sex can use this route too [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]]. Our story on that ruling explains why it matters while criminal law still shields husbands.

Nor does she need anyone's permission. An adult woman's own consent is the only consent the Act asks for; not a husband's, not her parents', not her in-laws'. A guardian's written consent is needed only if she is under 18 [[gazette-mtp-act-1971]]. In that case the doctor must also report the pregnancy to the police under POCSO, but need not name her in that report if she and her guardian ask [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]].

## Up to 20 weeks, up to 24 weeks: the timeline

**Up to nine weeks:** a qualified doctor can prescribe the mifepristone-misoprostol combination, which succeeds in 95-99% of early abortions [[mohfw-cac-guidelines-2023]]. Pills bought over a counter without a prescription fall outside that safety net.

**Up to 20 weeks:** the opinion of one registered doctor is enough [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]].

**From 20 to 24 weeks:** two registered doctors must agree, and only women in categories listed in the rules qualify [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. Rule 3B, notified on 12 October 2021, lists seven categories. Survivors of sexual assault, rape or incest come first [[gazette-mtp-amendment-rules-2021]].

Each gate adds a doctor and narrows who qualifies. So book the appointment in the week the test turns positive, even before she has decided. Choosing to continue the pregnancy is equally her right, and the support below applies either way.

## Free treatment, privacy and compensation

Section 397 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) obliges every hospital, public or private, to give a rape survivor immediate first aid or medical treatment free of cost [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. A private hospital may not turn her away or hand her a bill. Know the section's other half before walking in: the hospital must also inform the police [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Telling a hospital about the rape sets off that report whether or not she wants a case. What the law does not do is make her abortion wait for one.

Her medical record is protected too. Since 2021, a doctor who reveals the name or details of a woman whose pregnancy was ended, to anyone not authorised by law, faces up to a year in prison, a fine, or both [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]].

Then the money, which few survivors are ever told about. The National Legal Services Authority's (NALSA) 2018 compensation scheme sets Rs 3 lakh to Rs 4 lakh for a pregnancy resulting from rape, a separate line from the Rs 4 lakh to Rs 7 lakh it lists for rape [[nalsa-compensation-scheme-women-2018]]. The wording, "in case of pregnancy on account of rape", makes no distinction between ending the pregnancy and continuing it. Limits are 50% higher for a minor, and the inquiry must finish within 60 days [[nalsa-compensation-scheme-women-2018]]. Under Section 396 BNSS, she can apply directly to the District or State Legal Services Authority even if the offender is never traced and no trial takes place [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Actual payouts depend on the state and district authorities [[nalsa-compensation-scheme-women-2018]].

She does not have to do this alone. One Stop Centres exist to help women through exactly these steps; in July 2026, 985 of the 1,033 approved across India were operational [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]].

## Past 24 weeks: the court route

After week 24, the MTP Act keeps one planned door open, and it is not hers. There is no upper limit only when a Medical Board finds a substantial foetal abnormality [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. A rape survivor past 24 weeks has no route in the Act except a termination immediately needed to save her life, and must otherwise petition a High Court or the Supreme Court [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. Our Q&A on the 24-week wall explains what a petition involves.

If the pregnancy is nearing week 24, find a lawyer the same day; Legal Services Authorities provide free legal aid [[nalsa]]. Every day spent drafting is a day added to the pregnancy.

The deadline that matters most is the first one: a test, a date and a doctor, all in the same week.
pregnant-after-rape-rights-guide-india.hg:
Ek situation sochiye. Patna ki ek 24 saal ki aurat ka rape uske jaan-pehchaan ke ek aadmi ne kiya. Paanch hafte baad bhi uska period nahi aaya, aur chemist se laaye test par do lines dikh rahi hain. Woh police ke paas nahi gayi hai, aur use pakka nahi pata ki kabhi jaayegi bhi ya nahi. Is waqt use apne beete kal par kisi ki salaah nahi, ek calendar chahiye, kyunki yahan se uska lagbhag har haq hafton mein chalne wali ek ghadi par tika hai. Yeh guide wahi calendar hai, step by step. Yeh general jaankari hai, legal advice nahi.

## Kya woh pregnant hai? Test aur hafton ki ginti

Agar assault ko paanch din se kam hue hain, toh pregnancy ab bhi roki ja sakti hai. Emergency contraception ovulation ko aage khiska kar kaam karti hai; jo pregnancy shuru ho chuki hai, use yeh khatam nahi karti, isliye yeh abortion nahi hai [[who-ec]]. Assault ke baad ke pehle 72 ghanton par hamari guide us waqt ko cover karti hai. Yeh guide wahan se shuru hoti hai jahan woh khatam hoti hai.

Period late ho jaaye, toh urine test zyada tar pregnancies pakad leta hai. Agar test negative aaye aur period phir bhi na aaye, toh kuch din baad dobara test karna chahiye. Phir doctor ka examination, ya dates saaf na hon toh ultrasound, batata hai ki pregnancy kitne hafte ki hai.

Ek baat par families aksar chook jaati hain. Doctor pregnancy ke hafte aakhri period ke pehle din se ginte hain, assault ke din se nahi; Health Ministry ki abortion pills wali nau hafte (63 din) ki limit bhi isi tarah gini jaati hai [[mohfw-cac-guidelines-2023]]. Kaagaz par pregnancy hamesha utne se aage hoti hai jitne din assault ko hue hain. Neeche ki har deadline uski ummeed se pehle aa jaati hai.

## Law kya maan kar chalta hai, aur kya nahi maangta

Medical Termination of Pregnancy (MTP) Act kehta hai ki jab koi aurat kehti hai ki uski pregnancy rape se hui hai, toh us pregnancy se hone wali peeda ko uski mental health ke liye gambhir nuksaan maana jaata hai. Yahi maanyata pregnancy khatam karne ka ek legal aadhaar hai [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. Use yeh dikhana nahi padta ki woh takleef mein hai. Law yeh khud maan leta hai.

Use rape saabit bhi nahi karna padta. 29 September 2022 ko Supreme Court ne kaha ki MTP Act ke liye rape ke aarop ko sach maanne se pehle na FIR darj honi zaroori hai, na kisi court mein aarop saabit hona. Isi faisle ne Act mein "rape" ke matlab mein pati dwara kiya gaya rape bhi shamil kiya, yaani jo wife zabardasti sex se pregnant hui hai, woh bhi yahi raasta le sakti hai [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]]. Us faisle par hamari story batati hai ki yeh kyun maayne rakhta hai, jabki criminal law aaj bhi pati ko bachata hai.

Use kisi ki permission bhi nahi chahiye. Adult aurat ki apni consent hi akeli consent hai jo Act maangta hai; na pati ki, na maa-baap ki, na sasural walon ki. Guardian ki likhit consent sirf tab chahiye jab woh 18 saal se kam ki ho [[gazette-mtp-act-1971]]. Us case mein doctor ko POCSO ke tahat police ko pregnancy ki jaankari bhi deni hoti hai, lekin agar ladki aur uska guardian kahein, toh us report mein uska naam dena zaroori nahi [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]].

## 20 hafte tak, 24 hafte tak: timeline

**Nau hafte tak:** qualified doctor mifepristone-misoprostol combination prescribe kar sakta hai, jo shuruaati abortions mein 95-99% case mein kaamyab hota hai [[mohfw-cac-guidelines-2023]]. Bina prescription counter se khareedi gayi pills is safety net ke bahar hain.

**20 hafte tak:** ek registered doctor ki raay kaafi hai [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]].

**20 se 24 hafte:** do registered doctors ka sehmat hona zaroori hai, aur sirf rules mein likhi categories ki auratein hi eligible hain [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. 12 October 2021 ko notify hua Rule 3B saat categories ginata hai. Sexual assault, rape ya incest ki survivors list mein sabse pehle hain [[gazette-mtp-amendment-rules-2021]].

Har gate par ek doctor badh jaata hai aur eligible auraton ka daayra chhota hota jaata hai. Isliye jis hafte test positive aaye, usi hafte appointment book kar lena chahiye, chahe faisla abhi na hua ho. Pregnancy jaari rakhna bhi utna hi uska haq hai, aur neeche likhi saari madad dono haalaton mein milti hai.

## Free ilaaj, privacy aur compensation

Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) ka Section 397 har hospital ko, sarkari ho ya private, rape survivor ko turant first aid ya medical ilaaj free mein dene ke liye baadhya karta hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Koi private hospital use lauta nahi sakta, na uske haath mein bill thama sakta hai. Hospital jaane se pehle is section ka doosra hissa bhi jaan lena chahiye: hospital ko police ko bhi khabar karni hoti hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Hospital ko rape ke baare mein batate hi yeh report chali jaati hai, chahe woh case chahti ho ya nahi. Lekin law uske abortion ko kisi case ke intezaar mein nahi rokta.

Uska medical record bhi surakshit hai. 2021 se, jo doctor kisi aisi aurat ka naam ya details, jiski pregnancy khatam ki gayi ho, kisi aise insaan ko bataye jise law ne authorise nahi kiya, use ek saal tak ki jail, jurmana, ya dono ho sakte hain [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]].

Ab paison ki baat, jiske baare mein bahut kam survivors ko kabhi bataya jaata hai. National Legal Services Authority (NALSA) ki 2018 compensation scheme rape se hui pregnancy ke liye Rs 3 lakh se Rs 4 lakh tay karti hai. Yeh rape ke liye likhe Rs 4 lakh se Rs 7 lakh se alag line hai [[nalsa-compensation-scheme-women-2018]]. Scheme ke shabd, "in case of pregnancy on account of rape", pregnancy khatam karne aur use jaari rakhne mein koi farak nahi karte. Minor ke liye limits 50% zyada hain, aur inquiry 60 din ke andar poori honi chahiye [[nalsa-compensation-scheme-women-2018]]. BNSS ke Section 396 ke tahat woh seedhe District ya State Legal Services Authority mein apply kar sakti hai, chahe offender kabhi pakda na jaaye aur koi trial na ho [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Asal mein kitna paisa milta hai, yeh state aur district authorities par nirbhar karta hai [[nalsa-compensation-scheme-women-2018]].

Use yeh sab akele nahi karna hai. One Stop Centres theek inhi kadmon mein auraton ki madad ke liye bane hain; July 2026 mein poore India mein approve hue 1,033 mein se 985 chal rahe the [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]].

## 24 hafte ke baad: court ka raasta

24ve hafte ke baad MTP Act ek hi tay darwaza khula rakhta hai, aur woh uske liye nahi hai. Koi upper limit sirf tab nahi rehti jab Medical Board pregnancy mein koi substantial foetal abnormality paaye [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. 24 hafte ke baad rape survivor ke liye Act mein koi raasta nahi hai, siwaay us termination ke jo uski jaan bachane ke liye turant zaroori ho; warna use High Court ya Supreme Court mein petition daalni padti hai [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. 24 hafte ki deewar par hamara Q&A samjhata hai ki petition mein kya-kya hota hai.

Agar pregnancy 24ve hafte ke kareeb hai, toh usi din lawyer dhoondhna chahiye; Legal Services Authorities free legal aid deti hain [[nalsa]]. Petition likhne mein laga har din pregnancy mein ek din aur jod deta hai.

Sabse zaroori deadline pehli wali hai: ek test, ek date aur ek doctor, sab ek hi hafte mein.

pregnant-child-survivors-support-compens.en:
Imagine a mother in a small town who learns that her 15-year-old daughter is pregnant after being raped. In one afternoon she has to think about a police case, a hospital, money, her daughter's school and what the neighbours will say. Most families in that position do not know that the state has made specific promises to girls like hers. Here is what those promises are. This is general information, not legal advice.

The scale is not small. In 2024 police registered 43,313 cases of penetrative or aggravated penetrative sexual assault on girls under Sections 4 and 6 of the POCSO Act, the law's child-rape sections, involving 43,675 girls [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Of all 44,567 child victims of such assault that year, boys included, 23,497, or 52.7%, were aged 16 or 17 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. These police tables do not show how many of the girls became pregnant.

## Who does the 2023 scheme cover?

In a letter dated 30 November 2023, the Ministry of Women and Child Development introduced the "Scheme for Care and Support to Victims under Section 4 & 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012", centrally funded and paid for from the Nirbhaya Fund [[mwcd-pocso-victim-support-scheme-2023]]. It is meant for minor girls who become pregnant as a result of the assaults those two sections cover. The ministry's own letter notes that a disproportionate number of victims are girls aged 13 to 18.

A minor here means a girl under 18. Since 2013, sex with a girl under 18 has been rape whether or not she agreed [[prs-madhavan-sexual-offences-2013]]. So a pregnancy at 15 or 16 is, in law, evidence of a sexual offence, whether the accused is a stranger, a relative or a "boyfriend".

## What help does it promise, and where?

The letter lists what the scheme should bring together under one roof: shelter, police assistance, medical care including maternity, neonatal and infant care, psychological and mental-health counselling, legal support and access to education [[mwcd-pocso-victim-support-scheme-2023]]. The point is that a pregnant 15-year-old should not have to go from office to office, retelling what happened at each one.

Where to ask: once a POCSO case is registered, police must report it to the Child Welfare Committee and the Special Court within 24 hours [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. That committee, and the district child-protection staff who run the Child Helpline 1098, which is linked to the 112 emergency system [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]], are the people to ask for the scheme by name.

Some help does not depend on the scheme at all. Under Section 397 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), every hospital, public or private, must give a POCSO survivor immediate free first aid or medical treatment [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

We could not verify how many girls the scheme has reached so far. A scheme that local officials have not heard of helps nobody, so ask for it by name, and in writing.

## How much compensation, and does it need a conviction?

Compensation runs on a separate track, through Legal Services Authorities. NALSA's 2018 compensation scheme for women survivors lists "pregnancy on account of rape" as its own entry, at Rs 3 lakh to Rs 4 lakh, apart from the entry for rape itself, at Rs 4 lakh to Rs 7 lakh [[nalsa-compensation-scheme-women-2018]]. When the victim is a minor, the limits are treated as 50% higher, and the inquiry must be finished within 60 days [[nalsa-compensation-scheme-women-2018]]. It is a model scheme, so what is actually paid depends on the state and district authority.

No conviction is needed. Under Section 396 of the BNSS, which replaced Section 357A of the old CrPC, a victim can apply directly to the State or District Legal Services Authority even if the offender is never traced and no trial takes place, and the authority must decide within two months [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. That matters, because most trials do not end in a conviction: in 2024, courts convicted in only 32.3% of POCSO cases whose trials ended [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The same authorities also give free legal aid [[nalsa]].

## Does she have to continue the pregnancy?

No. Survivors of rape and minors are both among the groups the MTP Rules allow to end a pregnancy up to 24 weeks [[gazette-mtp-amendment-rules-2021]]. Up to 20 weeks, one registered doctor's opinion is enough; between 20 and 24 weeks, two must agree [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. When a pregnancy is said to be caused by rape, the law presumes the anguish it causes to be a grave injury to her mental health, which is a legal ground for ending it [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. For a girl under 18, the doctor also needs her guardian's written consent [[gazette-mtp-act-1971]].

Time matters. Beyond 24 weeks, the Act lifts the limit only when a Medical Board finds a substantial foetal abnormality [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. Unless a termination is immediately necessary to save her life, a survivor past that line has to petition a High Court or the Supreme Court.

A doctor who ends a minor's pregnancy must still inform the police, but since September 2022 her name and personal details can be left out of that report if she and her guardian ask [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]]. If she decides to continue the pregnancy instead, the scheme's maternity, neonatal and infant care is meant for exactly that path.

## What about school and the future?

Education support is part of the scheme [[mwcd-pocso-victim-support-scheme-2023]], so ask the officials handling her case to write down exactly what she will get, whether that is help with fees and books, a change of school or arrangements for exams.

Her privacy has legal protection. Section 23 of the POCSO Act bars any media report from revealing a child victim's name, address, photograph, family details, school or neighbourhood; a violation is punishable with 6 months to 1 year in prison, a fine, or both [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Within the family and the school, the rule should be the same: her story is not anyone else's to tell.

Plan for a long road. At the end of 2024, 2,86,903 POCSO cases were waiting for trial [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Her schooling, her counselling and the family's finances cannot wait for a verdict, and compensation, at least, does not have to. What she needs most in the meantime is an adult who believes her and stays.
pregnant-child-survivors-support-compens.hg:
Sochiye, ek chhote shehar ki ek maa ko pata chalta hai ki uski 15 saal ki beti rape ke baad pregnant hai. Ek hi dopahar mein use police case, hospital, paise, beti ke school aur "padosi kya kahenge", sab ke baare mein sochna padta hai. Aisi haalat mein zyada tar parivaaron ko pata hi nahi hota ki sarkar ne aisi ladkiyon se kuch khaas vaade kiye hain. Yeh rahe woh vaade. Yeh jaankari general samajh ke liye hai, legal advice nahi.

Yeh koi chhoti sankhya nahi hai. 2024 mein police ne POCSO Act ke Section 4 aur 6, yaani kanoon ke child-rape wale sections, ke tahat ladkiyon ke saath penetrative ya aggravated penetrative sexual assault ke 43,313 cases darj kiye, jinmein 43,675 ladkiyan victim thi [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Us saal aise assault ke kul 44,567 child victims mein, ladkon ko milakar, 23,497 yaani 52.7% 16 ya 17 saal ke the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Police ke yeh tables yeh nahi batate ki inmein se kitni ladkiyan pregnant hui.

## 2023 ki scheme kin ladkiyon ke liye hai?

30 November 2023 ki ek chitthi mein Ministry of Women and Child Development ne "Scheme for Care and Support to Victims under Section 4 & 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012" shuru ki. Yeh centrally funded hai aur Nirbhaya Fund se chalti hai [[mwcd-pocso-victim-support-scheme-2023]]. Yeh un minor ladkiyon ke liye hai jo in do sections mein aane wale assault ki wajah se pregnant ho gayi hain. Ministry ki apni chitthi kehti hai ki victims mein 13 se 18 saal ki ladkiyon ki sankhya bahut zyada hai.

Yahan minor ka matlab hai 18 se kam umar ki ladki. 2013 se, 18 se kam umar ki ladki ke saath sex rape hai, chahe usne haan kaha ho ya nahi [[prs-madhavan-sexual-offences-2013]]. Isliye 15 ya 16 ki umar mein pregnancy kanoon ki nazar mein sexual offence ka saboot hai, chahe accused koi ajnabi ho, rishtedaar ho ya "boyfriend".

## Kya madad milti hai, aur kahan?

Chitthi mein likha hai ki scheme ek hi chhat ke neeche kya-kya laayegi: rehne ki jagah (shelter), police ki madad, ilaaj jismein delivery, navjaat aur shishu ki dekhbhaal bhi shaamil hai, psychological aur mental health counselling, legal support aur padhai tak pahunch [[mwcd-pocso-victim-support-scheme-2023]]. Maqsad yeh hai ki ek pregnant 15 saal ki ladki ko ek office se doosre office na bhatakna pade, aur har jagah apni aapbeeti dobara na sunani pade.

Kahan poochein: POCSO case darj hone ke baad police ko 24 ghante ke andar Child Welfare Committee aur Special Court ko report karna hota hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Yahi committee, aur district ka child-protection staff jo Child Helpline 1098 chalata hai, jo 112 emergency system se judi hai [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]], woh log hain jinse scheme ka naam lekar madad maangni chahiye.

Kuch madad scheme par nirbhar hi nahi hai. Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) ke Section 397 ke tahat har hospital, sarkari ho ya private, ko POCSO survivor ko turant free first aid ya ilaaj dena hota hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

Hum yeh verify nahi kar paaye ki ab tak scheme kitni ladkiyon tak pahunchi hai. Jis scheme ke baare mein local officials ne suna hi nahi, woh kisi ki madad nahi karti, isliye uska naam lekar maangiye, aur likhit mein maangiye.

## Kitna compensation, aur kya iske liye conviction zaroori hai?

Compensation ek alag raaste se aata hai, Legal Services Authorities ke zariye. Women survivors ke liye NALSA ki 2018 ki compensation scheme mein "pregnancy on account of rape" ki apni alag entry hai, Rs 3 lakh se Rs 4 lakh. Yeh rape ki entry se alag hai, jiske liye range Rs 4 lakh se Rs 7 lakh hai [[nalsa-compensation-scheme-women-2018]]. Victim minor ho toh limits 50% zyada maani jaati hain, aur inquiry 60 din ke andar poori honi chahiye [[nalsa-compensation-scheme-women-2018]]. Yeh ek model scheme hai, isliye asal mein kitna milta hai, yeh state aur district authority par nirbhar karta hai.

Conviction zaroori nahi hai. BNSS ke Section 396 ke tahat, jisne purane CrPC ke Section 357A ki jagah li hai, victim seedhe State ya District Legal Services Authority mein apply kar sakti hai, chahe offender kabhi pakda na jaaye aur trial hi na ho, aur authority ko do mahine ke andar faisla karna hota hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Yeh isliye zaroori hai kyunki zyada tar trials conviction par khatam nahi hote: 2024 mein jin POCSO cases ke trial poore hue, unmein se sirf 32.3% mein courts ne accused ko doshi thehraya [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yahi authorities free legal aid bhi deti hain [[nalsa]].

## Kya use pregnancy jaari rakhni padegi?

Nahi. MTP Rules jin groups ko 24 hafte tak pregnancy khatam karne ki ijaazat dete hain, unmein rape survivors aur minors dono hain [[gazette-mtp-amendment-rules-2021]]. 20 hafte tak ek registered doctor ki raay kaafi hai; 20 se 24 hafte ke beech do doctors ka sehmat hona zaroori hai [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. Jab kaha jaaye ki pregnancy rape se hui hai, toh kanoon maanta hai ki usse hone wali takleef uski mental health ko gambhir nuksaan hai, aur yeh pregnancy khatam karne ka kanooni aadhaar hai [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. 18 se kam umar ki ladki ke liye doctor ko uske guardian ki likhit consent bhi chahiye [[gazette-mtp-act-1971]].

Waqt bahut maayne rakhta hai. 24 hafte ke baad Act yeh limit sirf tab hatata hai jab Medical Board foetus mein koi badi abnormality paaye [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. Agar uski jaan bachane ke liye termination turant zaroori na ho, toh us line ke paar pahunchi survivor ko High Court ya Supreme Court mein petition daalni padti hai.

Jo doctor kisi minor ki pregnancy khatam karta hai, use ab bhi police ko batana hota hai. Lekin September 2022 se, agar ladki aur uske guardian kahein, toh us report mein uska naam aur personal details likhna zaroori nahi [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]]. Agar woh pregnancy jaari rakhne ka faisla karti hai, toh scheme ki delivery, navjaat aur shishu dekhbhaal usi raaste ke liye hai.

## School aur aage ki zindagi ka kya?

Padhai mein madad scheme ka hissa hai [[mwcd-pocso-victim-support-scheme-2023]], isliye case sambhaal rahe officials se likhit mein poochiye ki use theek-theek kya milega: fees aur kitaabon mein madad, school badalna, ya exams ke liye intezaam.

Uski privacy ko kanooni suraksha mili hai. POCSO Act ka Section 23 kisi bhi media report ko child victim ka naam, pata, photo, family details, school ya mohalla batane se rokta hai; iska ullanghan karne par 6 mahine se 1 saal tak ki jail, fine, ya dono ho sakte hain [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Parivaar aur school ke andar bhi yahi niyam hona chahiye: uski kahani kisi aur ke sunane ki cheez nahi hai.

Lambe raaste ke liye taiyaar rahiye. 2024 ke aakhir mein 2,86,903 POCSO cases trial ka intezaar kar rahe the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Uski padhai, uski counselling aur parivaar ka kharcha faisle ka intezaar nahi kar sakte, aur kam se kam compensation ke liye intezaar karna zaroori nahi. Is beech use sabse zyada zaroorat ek aise bade ki hai jo uski baat par yakeen kare aur uske saath khada rahe.

pregnant-minor-pocso-reporting-trap.en:
Imagine a 16-year-old in Indore whose test from the chemist shows two lines. Her first fear is who will find out: her parents, the neighbours, the police. A friend knows a "clinic" that asks no questions. A real doctor, she has heard, will call the police. She is right, and the law that makes her right was written to protect her.

## Why every pregnancy under 18 is a police matter

Since 2013, sex with a girl under 18 has been rape whether or not she agreed; the age was raised from 16 [[prs-madhavan-sexual-offences-2013]]. Since 2017 that holds even if she is married: the Supreme Court ruled that sex with a wife under 18 is rape [[sc-independent-thought-2017]]. So a pregnancy at 16 is, in law, evidence of a sexual offence.

The Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act then makes silence a crime. Sections 19 and 21 require anyone who knows of a sexual offence against a child to report it. Failing to report can mean up to 6 months in prison, a fine or both; the head of a company or institution who fails to report abuse by someone under their control faces up to 1 year and a fine [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. A doctor who sees a pregnant 16-year-old knows. Only a child cannot be punished for staying silent.

The rule exists for real reasons. In 2024 police recorded 44,567 child victims of penetrative sexual assault, and 23,497 of them, 52.7%, were aged 16-18 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Family members were the accused in 3,658 of 44,126 such cases [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. NCRB does not separately count cases that began as teenage relationships; the law treats them all the same.

## The Supreme Court's own warning in 2022

On 29 September 2022, in X v. Principal Secretary, the Supreme Court described what the reporting rule does to a pregnant girl:

> "Minors and their guardians are likely faced with two options – one, approach an RMP and possibly be involved in criminal proceedings under the POCSO Act, or two, approach an unqualified doctor for a medical termination of the pregnancy." [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]]

An RMP is a registered medical practitioner. The second option is the one that can kill. UNFPA India estimated in 2022 that unsafe abortion is India's third leading cause of maternal deaths, with close to eight women dying every day from related causes, and that girls aged 15-19 face the highest risk of dying from abortion complications [[unfpa-swop-2022-india-insights]]. The estimates rest on old data; the WHO's contrast is stark: deaths from safe abortion are under 1 per 100,000 abortions, against more than 200 per 100,000 where unsafe abortion is common [[who-abortion-factsheet-2025]].

The quack faces two to seven years of rigorous imprisonment under the MTP Act [[indiankanoon-mtp-act-1971-consolidated]]. That is no comfort to a girl who has already gone to one.

## The fix: a report without her name

The court did not remove the duty to report. It narrowed what the report must say. A doctor ending a minor's pregnancy must still inform the police under Section 19(1), but need not disclose her identity or personal details in that report if she and her guardian ask. The doctor is also exempt from disclosing her identity in any criminal case that follows [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]]. Our timeline of child-protection law lists this ruling; at a clinic, it is the sentence a family needs.

The legal window is also wider for her than for most adult women: minors are one of the seven categories allowed an abortion up to 24 weeks [[gazette-mtp-amendment-rules-2021]], and the procedure needs the written consent of a guardian [[gazette-mtp-act-1971]].

## What the fix leaves broken

First, it runs through a guardian. The name stays out only if the girl and her guardian both ask, and no doctor may end her pregnancy without a guardian's written consent. A girl who cannot tell her parents, or whose pregnancy came from someone inside the family, is the girl this fix helps least.

Second, the report is still made, and any case that begins joins a long queue: 2,86,903 POCSO cases were waiting for trial at the end of 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Third, it covers only abortion. The court limited its clarification to "the limited purposes of providing medical termination of pregnancy" [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]]. A girl who continues the pregnancy falls outside it.

And it cannot help a girl who has never heard of it.

## If it is your sister or friend: safe next steps

If she tells you, the next few days matter most. This is general information, not legal advice.

**Move fast, but not to a chemist.** The abortion-pill combination is approved for use up to nine weeks (63 days) of pregnancy, prescribed by a qualified doctor [[mohfw-cac-guidelines-2023]]. Pills bought or taken without one fall outside that safety net.

**Go to a registered doctor or a government hospital** with a parent or guardian, since a minor's abortion needs a guardian's written consent. She and her guardian can ask for her name and details to be left out of the police report; name the case: X v. Principal Secretary, 29 September 2022.

**If she was abused, or has no safe adult at home**, call the Child Helpline 1098, which is linked to the 112 emergency system [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]]. Since November 2023 a central scheme has offered girls under 18 made pregnant by rape shelter, medical and maternity care, legal aid, counselling and education support under one roof [[mwcd-pocso-victim-support-scheme-2023]].

**Know where you stand.** If you are under 18, the law does not punish you for not reporting. If you are an adult, the duty applies to you too, and helping her hide the pregnancy or reach a quack puts both of you at risk.

Above all, stay with her. The law offers her a safe route, and it is easier to take with someone beside her.
pregnant-minor-pocso-reporting-trap.hg:
Sochiye, Indore ki ek 16 saal ki ladki. Chemist se laayi test kit par do lines dikhti hain. Uska pehla darr yeh hai ki kise pata chalega: mummy-papa ko, padosiyon ko, police ko. Ek saheli ko ek "clinic" pata hai jahan koi sawaal nahi poochta. Usne suna hai ki asli doctor police ko bata dega. Usne sahi suna hai, aur jis kanoon ki wajah se aisa hota hai, woh usi ki hifazat ke liye bana tha.

## 18 se kam umar ki har pregnancy police tak kyun jaati hai

2013 se, 18 saal se kam umar ki ladki ke saath sex rape hai, chahe usne haan kaha ho ya nahi. Pehle yeh umar 16 saal thi [[prs-madhavan-sexual-offences-2013]]. 2017 se yeh baat shaadishuda ladki par bhi laagu hai: Supreme Court ne kaha ki 18 se kam umar ki wife ke saath sex bhi rape hai [[sc-independent-thought-2017]]. Yaani 16 ki umar mein pregnancy, kanoon ki nazar mein sexual offence ka saboot hai.

Phir Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act chup rehne ko bhi jurm bana deta hai. Section 19 aur 21 kehte hain ki kisi bachche ke saath sexual offence ki jaankari jise bhi ho, use report karna hoga. Report na karne par 6 mahine tak ki jail, fine ya dono ho sakte hain; aur jo company ya institution ka head apne neeche kaam karne wale kisi insaan ka abuse report na kare, use 1 saal tak ki jail aur fine ho sakta hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Jo doctor 16 saal ki pregnant ladki ko dekhta hai, use jaankari hai. Sirf bachchon ko chup rehne ki saza nahi mil sakti.

Yeh rule bewajah nahi hai. 2024 mein police ne penetrative sexual assault ke 44,567 child victims darj kiye, aur inmein se 23,497, yaani 52.7%, 16 se 18 saal ke the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Aise 44,126 cases mein se 3,658 mein accused family ka hi member tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. NCRB un cases ko alag se nahi ginta jo teenagers ke aapsi rishte se shuru hue; kanoon bhi sabko ek jaisa maanta hai.

## 2022 mein Supreme Court ki apni warning

29 September 2022 ko X v. Principal Secretary case mein Supreme Court ne bataya ki yeh reporting rule ek pregnant ladki ke saath kya karta hai:

> "Minors and their guardians are likely faced with two options – one, approach an RMP and possibly be involved in criminal proceedings under the POCSO Act, or two, approach an unqualified doctor for a medical termination of the pregnancy." [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]]

Yaani: ya toh registered doctor ke paas jaao aur POCSO ke criminal case mein phansne ka risk lo, ya kisi jholachhap ke paas jaao. RMP matlab registered medical practitioner. Doosra raasta jaan le sakta hai. UNFPA India ne 2022 mein andaaza lagaya ki India mein maternal deaths ki teesri sabse badi wajah unsafe abortion hai, isse judi wajahon se roz kareeb aath auratein marti hain, aur 15-19 saal ki ladkiyon ko abortion complications se maut ka sabse zyada khatra hai [[unfpa-swop-2022-india-insights]]. Yeh andaaze purane data par tike hain, par WHO ka fark saaf dikhata hai: safe abortion mein har 1 lakh abortions par 1 se bhi kam maut hoti hai, jabki jahan unsafe abortion aam hai, wahan har 1 lakh par 200 se zyada [[who-abortion-factsheet-2025]].

Jholachhap ko MTP Act ke tahat 2 se 7 saal ki sakht qaid ho sakti hai [[indiankanoon-mtp-act-1971-consolidated]]. Lekin jo ladki uske paas ja chuki hai, uske liye yeh koi raahat nahi.

## Hal: report, par ladki ke naam ke bina

Court ne report karne ki zimmedari khatam nahi ki. Usne bas yeh tay kiya ki report mein kya likhna zaroori hai. Minor ka abortion karne wale doctor ko ab bhi Section 19(1) ke tahat police ko batana hoga. Lekin agar ladki aur uske guardian kahein, toh report mein uska naam ya personal details likhna zaroori nahi. Aage koi criminal case chale, toh usme bhi doctor ko uski pehchaan batane ki zaroorat nahi [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]]. Child protection law ki hamari timeline mein yeh faisla ek padaav hai; clinic mein family ke liye sabse kaam ki baat yahi hai.

Aur uske liye kanooni window zyada tar adult aurton se badi bhi hai: rules mein jin saat categories ko 24 hafte tak abortion ki ijaazat hai, unmein minors bhi hain [[gazette-mtp-amendment-rules-2021]], aur iske liye guardian ki likhit consent chahiye [[gazette-mtp-act-1971]].

## Is hal mein kya ab bhi toota hua hai

Pehli baat, sab kuch guardian se hokar jaata hai. Naam tabhi chhupega jab ladki aur guardian dono kahein, aur guardian ki likhit consent ke bina koi doctor abortion nahi kar sakta. Jo ladki mummy-papa ko bata hi nahi sakti, ya jiski pregnancy family ke hi kisi member se hui hai, use is hal se sabse kam madad milti hai.

Doosri baat, report toh phir bhi hoti hai, aur jo case shuru hota hai woh lambi line mein lag jaata hai: 2024 ke aakhir mein 2,86,903 POCSO cases trial ka intezaar kar rahe the [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Teesri baat, yeh hal sirf abortion ke liye hai. Court ne apni baat "the limited purposes of providing medical termination of pregnancy" tak seemit rakhi [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]]. Jo ladki pregnancy jaari rakhti hai, woh iske daayre se bahar hai.

Aur jis ladki ne is faisle ke baare mein suna hi nahi, uski yeh koi madad nahi kar sakta.

## Agar aapki behen ya saheli hai: safe agle kadam

Agar woh aapko batati hai, toh agle kuch din sabse zaroori hain. Yeh jaankari general samajh ke liye hai, legal advice nahi.

**Jaldi kijiye, par chemist ke paas nahi.** Abortion pills ka combination pregnancy ke 9 hafte (63 din) tak ke liye approved hai, aur use qualified doctor likhta hai [[mohfw-cac-guidelines-2023]]. Doctor ke bina khareedi ya li gayi pills is safety net se bahar hain.

**Registered doctor ya sarkari hospital jaaiye**, mummy-papa ya guardian ke saath, kyunki minor ke abortion ke liye guardian ki likhit consent chahiye. Ladki aur uske guardian doctor se keh sakte hain ki police report mein uska naam aur details na likhein; case ka naam bataiye: X v. Principal Secretary, 29 September 2022.

**Agar uske saath abuse hua hai, ya ghar par koi bharosemand bada nahi hai**, toh Child Helpline 1098 par call kijiye, jo 112 emergency system se judi hai [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]]. November 2023 se ek central scheme rape se pregnant hui minor ladkiyon ko ek hi chhat ke neeche madad deti hai: rehne ki jagah, ilaaj aur delivery ki dekhbhaal, legal aid, counselling aur padhai mein saath [[mwcd-pocso-victim-support-scheme-2023]].

**Apni sthiti jaaniye.** Agar aap 18 se kam umar ke hain, toh report na karne par kanoon aapko saza nahi deta. Agar aap adult hain, toh report karne ki zimmedari aap par bhi hai, aur uski pregnancy chhupana ya use jholachhap tak pahunchana aap dono ko khatre mein daalta hai.

Sabse badi baat, uske saath rahiye. Kanoon ne uske liye ek safe raasta rakha hai, aur koi saath ho toh us raaste par chalna aasaan ho jaata hai.

sex-determination-test-law-answered.en:
Picture a scan room anywhere in India. The scan is over, the heartbeat is strong, and a relative leans towards the screen: "Bas itna bata dijiye, ladka hai ya ladki?" The law's answer has been no since 1 January 1996, when the Pre-natal Diagnostic Techniques Act of 1994 came into force. In 2003 it was renamed the Pre-Conception and Pre-Natal Diagnostic Techniques (Prohibition of Sex Selection) Act [[mohfw-pndt-act-rules-2003]]. Known as the PC-PNDT Act, it bans sex selection before or after conception and the misuse of prenatal tests to find out a foetus's sex [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]]. Here are the questions people actually ask about it. What follows is general information, not legal advice.

## Is it a crime just to ask?

Yes, if you are asking for the sex to be found out or revealed. Under Section 23 of the Act, anyone who seeks a clinic's or a doctor's help for sex selection faces up to three years in prison and a fine of up to Rs 50,000 for a first offence, and up to five years and Rs 1 lakh for a repeat offence [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]]. That reaches the husband who asks and the relative who books the appointment.

Scans themselves are not the problem. The Act regulates prenatal tests; it does not ban them [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]]. An ultrasound to check how the baby is growing is legal and important, and no one should skip one out of fear of this law. What is banned is using the test to learn the sex.

The pregnant woman herself stands in a different position, which the fourth question explains.

## Can a doctor give a hint?

No. Section 5(2) says no person, including the person conducting the test, may tell the pregnant woman, her relatives or anyone else the sex of the foetus "by words, signs or in any other manner" [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]]. A smile at the screen, a "buy pink clothes", a code word over the phone: if it tells the sex, it is covered.

The rule is wider than it once was. The original 1994 text barred only the person conducting the procedure from telling the woman or her relatives. The 2003 wording covers everyone: the receptionist, the middleman, the colleague who glimpsed the screen [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]]. When a doctor says "I can't tell you", it is not stubbornness. Telling you would be a crime.

## What happens to the clinic?

A doctor or clinic owner who breaks the Act faces up to three years in prison and a fine of up to Rs 10,000, rising to five years and Rs 50,000 for a repeat offence [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]]. On paper, the doctor's first-offence fine is smaller than the family's. The heavier blow is professional. A doctor's registration is suspended once a court frames charges, removed for five years on a first conviction and removed permanently on a second [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]]. Every offence under the Act is cognisable, non-bailable and non-compoundable, which means it cannot be settled privately between the parties [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]].

What about ads online? The Act also bans advertising sex determination, including on the internet: Section 22 carries up to three years in prison and a fine of up to Rs 10,000 [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]]. A website or social media post offering to "tell" is not a loophole. It is evidence.

The gap between the law and its use is wide. Police registered only 31 cases under the PC-PNDT Act in 2024 [[ncrb-crime-in-india-2024-vol1]]. Most prosecutions start as court complaints that police data do not capture, but the number is still a reminder that this law works only when someone uses it.

## What if the family forces her?

Then the law starts on her side. Unless the contrary is proved, a court must presume that a pregnant woman who sought sex selection was compelled by her husband or another relative. A woman who was compelled is not punished, and the husband or relative can be held liable for abetment [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]].

Consider a hypothetical. A 26-year-old with a three-year-old daughter is pregnant again. Her mother-in-law books a scan at a clinic "where they tell", and her husband says it is only to be sure. In the eyes of the Act, the people pushing her are the ones at risk, not her.

That does not make the pressure easy to refuse. Taunts, threats or being pushed towards an abortion she does not want are abuse, whatever the family calls them. She can call the Women Helpline 181, or 112 if she is in danger, and she can be the one who reports the clinic.

## How do you complain, and is abortion still legal?

Start with the Appropriate Authority: the district health officials who enforce the Act. A court can take up a case only on a complaint from that authority or an officer it authorises, or from a person or social organisation that has given the authority at least 15 days' notice [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]]. So if officials sit on a complaint, you can take it to court yourself once the notice period is over. Before you complain, write down the date, the clinic's name, what was said or signalled and what was paid, and keep receipts and screenshots of any ads.

And abortion? It remains legal. Under the MTP Act as amended in 2021, a pregnancy of up to 20 weeks can be ended on the opinion of one registered doctor if continuing it would risk the woman's life or gravely injure her physical or mental health, or if there is a substantial risk of serious foetal abnormality [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. Between 20 and 24 weeks, it is allowed for categories of women set out in the rules, with two doctors agreeing [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]].

The PC-PNDT Act does not change any of that. It forbids choosing by sex, not ending a pregnancy. A woman who needs an abortion should go to a registered doctor or a government hospital, and not stay away because the two laws have been confused.
sex-determination-test-law-answered.hg:
India mein kahin bhi ek scan room sochiye. Scan ho chuka hai, dhadkan theek hai, aur ek rishtedaar screen ki taraf jhuk kar poochta hai: "Bas itna bata dijiye, ladka hai ya ladki?" Law ka jawaab 1 January 1996 se "nahi" hai, jab 1994 ka Pre-natal Diagnostic Techniques Act laagu hua. 2003 mein iska naam badal kar Pre-Conception and Pre-Natal Diagnostic Techniques (Prohibition of Sex Selection) Act rakha gaya [[mohfw-pndt-act-rules-2003]]. PC-PNDT Act ke naam se jaana jaane wala yeh law conception se pehle ya baad sex selection par, aur foetus ka sex pata karne ke liye prenatal tests ke galat istemaal par ban lagata hai [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]]. Neeche woh sawaal hain jo log sach mein poochte hain. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Kya sirf poochna bhi crime hai?

Haan, agar aap sex pata karwane ya batwane ke liye pooch rahe hain. Act ke Section 23 ke under, jo bhi sex selection ke liye kisi clinic ya doctor ki madad maange, use pehli baar mein teen saal tak ki jail aur Rs 50,000 tak ka fine ho sakta hai, aur dobara karne par paanch saal tak ki jail aur Rs 1 lakh tak ka fine [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]]. Yeh us pati par bhi laagu hota hai jo poochta hai, aur us rishtedaar par bhi jo appointment book karta hai.

Scan khud problem nahi hain. Act prenatal tests ko regulate karta hai, unpar ban nahi lagata [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]]. Baby ki growth check karne wala ultrasound legal bhi hai aur zaroori bhi, aur is law ke darr se kisi ko bhi scan nahi chhodna chahiye. Ban sirf test ka istemaal karke sex jaanne par hai.

Pregnant aurat khud ek alag position mein hai, jo chautha sawaal samjhata hai.

## Kya doctor ishaara de sakta hai?

Nahi. Section 5(2) kehta hai ki koi bhi insaan, test karne wale samet, pregnant aurat, uske rishtedaaron ya kisi aur ko foetus ka sex "by words, signs or in any other manner", yaani shabdon se, ishaaron se ya kisi bhi aur tareeke se, nahi bata sakta [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]]. Screen dekh kar ek muskaan, "pink kapde le lijiye", phone par koi code word: agar usse sex pata chalta hai, toh woh bhi isi mein aata hai.

Yeh rule pehle se zyada chauda hai. 1994 ke original text mein sirf procedure karne wale ko aurat ya uske rishtedaaron ko batane se roka gaya tha. 2003 ki wording sab par laagu hoti hai: receptionist, dalaal, woh colleague jisne screen par jhaank liya [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]]. Jab doctor kehta hai "main nahi bata sakta", toh yeh zidd nahi hai. Batana crime hoga.

## Clinic ka kya hota hai?

Jo doctor ya clinic owner Act todta hai, use teen saal tak ki jail aur Rs 10,000 tak ka fine ho sakta hai, aur dobara karne par paanch saal aur Rs 50,000 [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]]. Kaagaz par doctor ka pehli baar ka fine family ke fine se kam hai. Asli chot professional hai. Court charges frame kare, toh doctor ka registration suspend ho jaata hai; pehli conviction par paanch saal ke liye register se naam hat jaata hai, aur doosri par hamesha ke liye [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]]. Act ka har offence cognisable, non-bailable aur non-compoundable hai, yaani dono party aapas mein private settlement karke ise khatam nahi kar sakti [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]].

Online ads ka kya? Act sex determination ki advertising par bhi ban lagata hai, internet par bhi: Section 22 mein teen saal tak ki jail aur Rs 10,000 tak ka fine hai [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]]. Koi website ya social media post jo "batane" ki offer kare, woh koi loophole nahi hai. Woh saboot hai.

Law aur uske istemaal ke beech ka fasla bada hai. Police ne 2024 mein PC-PNDT Act ke under sirf 31 cases darj kiye [[ncrb-crime-in-india-2024-vol1]]. Zyada tar cases court complaint se shuru hote hain jo police data mein nahi aate, phir bhi yeh number yaad dilata hai ki yeh law tabhi kaam karta hai jab koi use istemaal kare.

## Agar family use majboor kare toh?

Toh law shuru se uske saath khada hai. Jab tak ulta saabit na ho, court ko maan kar chalna hota hai ki jis pregnant aurat ne sex selection karwaya, use uske pati ya kisi aur rishtedaar ne majboor kiya tha. Jis aurat ko majboor kiya gaya, use saza nahi milti, aur pati ya rishtedaar par abetment, yaani jurm mein madad ya uksaane, ki zimmedari aa sakti hai [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]].
